title: The utilization level of medical resources, health capital and financial asset allocation of middle-aged and elderly households
core_idea: Analyze how the utilization level of medical resources and households' health capital relate to financial market participation and asset allocation decisions of middle-aged and elderly households, using 2015 and 2018 CHARLS data and applying logit and tobit models plus a mediating-effect framework to explore mechanisms and heterogeneity across income and urban–rural groups.
tldr: Empirically investigate the relationship and mechanisms linking medical resource utilization and health capital to financial asset allocation among middle-aged and elderly households using CHARLS data and mediation and regression models, with attention to subgroup differences.
